posts.title: Revolution and youth are closely allied.
posts.body: can a revolution promise to adults? To some it brings disgrace, to others favor. But even that favor is questionable,

posts.title: The historic castle loomed over the town below
posts.body: Its stone walls and imposing towers a reminder of a bygone era. Inside, tapestries lined the walls, and suits of armor stood sentinel in the grand hall. From the ramparts, one could see for miles in every direction, a view that spoke of centuries of power and prestige.
